exp.desc:
- Automated server provisioning (10 min instead of 2 days)
- Containerised internal apps
- Backup, monitoring, network

cl.p1: we used to build new servers by hand from a wiki checklist nobody kept up to date. Two years ago I started automating it. A new server now takes ten minutes, and the checklist no longer exists.
cl.p2: I have eight years as a systems administrator at a mid-sized company. I picked up containers, pipelines and infrastructure as code through projects and a certification, and I would now like to work in a team where that is the norm.

cl.p1: our development teams deploy twenty times a day instead of once a week. Behind that is a platform I built with two colleagues: pipelines, container clusters, secrets management and monitoring that flags problems before customers notice.
cl.p2: Six years in operations, three of them on call, have taught me that a good postmortem matters more than finding someone to blame. I want to join a company that runs everyday transport for many people and therefore takes stability seriously.
